combat_wing: 40th CBW (92nd, 305th, 306th). Per 305-01 the 305th flew 'in the low group'; 306th records say only the 92nd and 306th made the wing rendezvous.
dispatched_notes: 305th mission report as quoted on 305-01: 18 started, 3 aborted, 11 lost en route, 3 reached/bombed Schweinfurt, 0 lost on return, 2 came home (the 13 losses = 11 en route plus Kincaid and Bullock at the target). The same 18/3 figures are given by the 305-07 comment (citing Kuhl). CONFLICT: the 303rd BG summary (305-05) and the IWM first-element list give 305BG as 16. Lost = 13 (Kuhl timeline lists 13 named aircraft); 'lost 13 of its 16' in the task brief matches the 16 figure.

aircraft.notes: Lead aircraft per Kuhl (305-01): Kane/Normand began the bomb run 14:32, bombs away 14:40, landed Chelveston 18:07; one of two 305th aircraft to return. Group leader G.Y. Normand flew as co-pilot/commander per 305-07. Crew list below comes only from a reader comment (Charlie Boruta, citing Kuhl's book) on 305-04 and is UNVERIFIED. Damage state not documented. research_gaps: The three aborted aircraft (serials, pilots, crews) were not identified in any source found.

No primary 305th records (loading lists, interrogation forms, MACR images) were found online; no 305th association website responded (305thbombgroup.com/.org, 305thbg.org do not resolve). Crew data come from the IWM American Air Museum archive (Dave Osborne B-17 master-log text plus volunteer person records) and b17flyingfortress.de, which share upstream sources, so most crew records are PROBABLE at best.
Many crew names are short forms (Bob, Chas, Vic, etc.) as given by the master-log text; full names found only where IWM person pages exist.
Where only group totals are given, individual fates are 'unknown' or, if assigned from list order or deduced from totals, marked UNVERIFIED with a note.
Farrell crew (42-30678) and the 3 aborts: no crew data. Kane/Normand crew (42-3412) from a single reader comment.
Ranks are missing for most crew; IWM 'Highest Rank' may postdate 14 Oct 1943.
Fate value 'interned' (Switzerland, Lazy Baby crew) is outside the schema's enumeration and is used deliberately.
MACR for 42-37750 conflicts (915 on IWM, 779 on the b17flyingfortress.de loss list). Crash locations sometimes differ between Kuhl and the master log (e.g. Lang: Puffendorf vs Beek).
americanairmuseum.com blocked automated fetch (403); IWM americanarchive pages used instead and rate-limited part-way (HTTP 429).

Searched: web search for 305th association/loading lists, IWM mission page VIII BC 115, IWM aircraft pages for all 15 known serials, ~50 IWM person pages, b17flyingfortress.de pages and loss list, 303rd mission 78 PDF.
